Good afternoon, Chidi. Good news — I checked the result with Access Bank and the transfer TRF-INV-88 for ₦250,000 to your Access Bank account (0234567891) was actually CREDITED on 21 Nov. Access Bank's final status is "success" / credited to your account. The "failed" label you saw on our side was a system glitch, not an actual failure.

Because the reference TRF-INV-88 has already been used for this paid transfer, I can't (and shouldn't) resend it — doing so would risk paying you twice.

Could you please confirm on your side that the ₦250,000 now shows in your account? Once you confirm, I'll correct the status on our records so it no longer shows as failed.

Access Bank already confirmed the ₦250,000 to your account 0234567891 was credited on 21 Nov (session/transaction 000014261121140211000088). Sending another transfer would pay you twice — and the reference TRF-INV-88 has already been used, so it can't be reused.

When a bank shows a transfer as "credited" but you can't see it, it's usually one of these:
- The funds landed but aren't on your available balance yet
- It appears as a separate bank credit/reconciliation entry until it settles
- A bank-side issue on the account

To sort it, please contact Access Bank directly (call or branch) and ask about the ₦250,000 credit dated 21 Nov, transaction 000014261121140211000088. They hold the real record and can tell you exactly where it is.
